models_evaluated: 8 state-of-the-art wrist-worn actigraphy sleep algorithms (regression-based, heuristic, machine learning, deep learning)

links.outcome: Sleep-wake classification and sleep outcome accuracy of complex vs simple algorithms against PSG on the same dataset
links.effect: Simple regression-based and heuristic algorithms showed slightly superior performance to recent complex ML/DL algorithms in sleep-wake classification and sleep outcome estimation.
links.quote: Despite the inclusion of recently published complex algorithms, simple regression-based and heuristic algorithms demonstrated slightly superior performance in sleep-wake classification and sleep outcome estimation.

links.outcome: Whether complex AI outperforms simpler methods on sleep scoring
links.effect: Complex ML/DL models did not outperform simple regression/heuristic algorithms; simpler methods were slightly superior and complex models seemed to generalize poorly.
links.quote: The performance of complex machine learning and deep learning models seem to suffer from poor generalization.

screen.reason: Systematic analytical benchmark comparing 8 sleep-wake classification algorithms (including ML/deep learning models vs traditional algorithms) against polysomnography ground truth on a common dataset.
